entries.said: The company planned to spend Rs. 25,000 crores in this financial year.
entries.quote: Our balance sheet continues to be very strong in spite of the capital expenditure. We invested nearly Rs.7,349 crores in this year and as we have mentioned to you we plan to spend Rs.25,000 crores in this financial year.
entries.speaker: Dr. Praveer Sinha
entries.delivered: Reported FY26 capex was INR 13,000 crores, missing the planned INR 25,000 crores target significantly.

entries.said: Our target of yearly investment continues to be the same at about INR25,000 crores.
entries.quote: So that's why our target of yearly investment continues to be the same. And there may be certain deferment by a quarter or 2. But otherwise, we are very much on track.
entries.speaker: Praveer Sinha
entries.delivered: Incurred INR 5,300 crores capex in Q1 FY27; full year results remain pending.
entries.evidence: Call c4 and Call c5 reported sections

entries.said: We can go up to 3 gigawatts of capacity add, and we are targeting 2.5 gigawatt next year for our own capacity.
entries.quote: Our own capacity. And just one addition to this is, what are the challenges are we facing in execution of our own capacity?
entries.speaker: Dr. Praveer Sinha
entries.delivered: Target reiterated in Call c5; full year results pending FY27 completion.
entries.evidence: Call c2 and Call c5 reported sections

entries.said: At the end of the year the company would have crossed nearly 7 gigawatts of operating renewable assets.
entries.quote: So, at the end of the year you will find that we would have crossed nearly 7 gigabytes of our operating renewable assets.
entries.speaker: Dr. Praveer Sinha
entries.delivered: Operating renewable capacity status was not detailed in reported highlights or financial tables.
entries.evidence: Call c3 reported section and annual table

entries.said: This year also, we have plans to grow by about 60% to 70%.
entries.quote: In fact, last year, we grew by 100%, and this year also, we have plans to grow by about 60% to 70%.
entries.speaker: Praveer Sinha
entries.delivered: Q1 FY27 revenue rose 5.6% YoY and Q2 FY27 rose 26.3% YoY; full FY27 pending.
entries.evidence: Quarterly table for Q1 and Q2 FY27

entries.said: I think on the EPC side, we kind of target PAT margin of close to 5% to 6% every quarter.
entries.quote: I think on the EPC side, we kind of target PAT margin of close to 5% to 6% every quarter.
entries.speaker: Sanjeev Churiwala
entries.delivered: EPC PAT margins are not explicitly reported in quarterly disclosures or tables.

summary: Management drastically missed its FY26 capex target, executing only INR 13,000 crores against INR 25,000 crores guidance. Operational capacity targets lack direct verification in financial tables, making execution reliability questionable despite ongoing FY27 plans.
business: Tata Power operates across power generation, solar cell and module manufacturing, rooftop solar, power distribution (Odisha Discoms), and EPC services.
bull: Q2 FY27 revenue grew 26.3% YoY to INR 19,636 crores, with PAT rising 32.7% YoY to INR 1,652 crores.
TTM PAT reached INR 5,663 crores, with EBITDA margins maintaining a healthy 20.0% level.
Solar cell and module manufacturing contributed INR 251 crores PAT in Q3 FY26, supporting profitability.
bear: Company missed FY26 capex guidance by 48%, spending INR 13,000 crores versus guided INR 25,000 crores.
FY26 annual revenue contracted by 4.7% YoY to INR 62,429 crores.
Total borrowings increased to INR 79,142 crores on the latest balance sheet.
